enonce.texte:
Complete the crossword puzzle with the numbers in English.

Across:
2. 15
4. 30
6. 8
7. 22
8. 12

Down:
1. 5
3. 18
5. 40
7. 25
images: A simple crossword grid with 8 columns and 8 rows, with numbers written in words as clues. The grid has boxes for letters and is suitable for beginners.

questions.texte: Identify the numbers and write their English names in the crossword.
questions.reponse: 2. fifteen, 4. thirty, 6. eight, 7. twenty-two, 8. twelve, 1. five, 3. eighteen, 5. forty, 7. twenty-five

sousQuestions.texte: Spell out the numbers from 1 to 10 in English.
sousQuestions.reponse: one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten

enonce.texte:
Sort the following words into the correct categories: Days of the week, Months of the year, and Seasons.

Words: Monday, January, Summer, December, Sunday, Autumn, July, Winter, February, Saturday, Spring, October

questions.texte: Create a table with three columns: 'Days', 'Months', and 'Seasons'. Place each word in the correct column.
questions.reponse: Days: Monday, Sunday, Saturday; Months: January, December, July, February, October; Seasons: Summer, Autumn, Winter, Spring

sousQuestions.texte: What is the first day of the week in English?
sousQuestions.reponse: Sunday (or Monday, depending on the convention)

enonce.texte:
Identify the colors of the following objects. Write the color name in English.

  • An apple
  • The sky
  • Grass
  • Snow
  • A banana
images: Apple, sky, grass, snow, and banana images in their natural colors.

questions.texte: Name the colors of the objects listed.
questions.reponse: Apple: red/green, Sky: blue, Grass: green, Snow: white, Banana: yellow

sousQuestions.texte: What is your favorite color? Explain in a sentence.

enonce.texte:
Fill out the form with your personal information. Use numbers, days, and months correctly.

Personal Information Form

  • Name: _______________
  • Age: _______________
  • Birthday: _______________ (day/month/year)
  • Favorite color: _______________
  • Number of family members: _______________

questions.texte: Complete the form with your own information.
questions.reponse: Depends on the student; example: Name: Jane Doe, Age: 15, Birthday: 01/01/2008, Favorite color: blue, Number of family members: 4

sousQuestions.texte: Describe your family using numbers and colors. Example: 'I have two brothers and one sister. Our favorite color is red.'
sousQuestions.reponse: Example: 'I have three brothers and two sisters. My mother's favorite color is green.'

enonce.texte:
Look at the following amounts in CFA francs and write the amount in English words. Then, convert them to US dollars using the exchange rate $1 = 600 CFA.

  • 600 CFA
  • 1200 CFA
  • 2550 CFA
  • 5400 CFA
images: Images of CFA coins and banknotes for illustration.

questions.texte: Write the amounts in English words and convert them to dollars.
questions.reponse: 600 CFA: six hundred CFA, $1; 1200 CFA: one thousand two hundred CFA, $2; 2550 CFA: two thousand five hundred fifty CFA, $4.25; 5400 CFA: five thousand four hundred CFA, $9

sousQuestions.texte: If you have 8000 CFA, how many dollars is that?

enonce.texte: Create a birthday calendar for your family. For each family member, write their name, birthday (day/month), age, and favorite color. Present your calendar to the class.

questions.texte: List your family members with their birthdays, ages, and favorite colors.
questions.reponse: Example: Mother: 12/March, 45, red; Father: 25/July, 48, blue; Sister: 5/November, 18, green; Brother: 14/January, 12, yellow

sousQuestions.texte: Who is the oldest in your family? How old are they?
sousQuestions.reponse: Example: My father is the oldest; he is 48 years old.

enonce.texte:
Read the following text and answer the questions.

My name is John. I am 12 years old. My birthday is on the 15th of August. I have a sister named Mary. She is 14 years old. Her birthday is on the 1st of January. We live in Yaoundé. Our favorite color is yellow. My mother is 40 years old, and my father is 45. They celebrate their birthdays in March and November.

questions.texte: Answer the following questions based on the text.

sousQuestions.reponse: Her birthday is on the 1st of January.

sousQuestions.texte: What is the family's favorite color?

enonce.texte:
Write a short paragraph (5-7 sentences) about your daily schedule. Include the time, days of the week, and numbers. Use the following structure:

  • What time do you wake up?
  • What do you eat for breakfast?
  • When do you go to school?
  • What do you do in the afternoon?
  • When do you have lunch?
  • What do you do in the evening?
  • What time do you go to bed?

questions.texte: Write your daily schedule in a paragraph.
questions.reponse: Example: 'I wake up at 6 o'clock in the morning. I eat bread and drink tea for breakfast. I go to school at 7 o'clock. In the afternoon, I do my homework and play with my friends. I have lunch at 12:30. In the evening, I watch TV and eat dinner at 8 o'clock. I go to bed at 9:30.'
